pages.title: A Drop of Order
pages.text: Move fluid through a Mechanical Pump and use a Spout to fill one compatible item.

pages.title: A Drop of Order
pages.text: Learn liquid handling through one small working line.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Connect the pump to a real fluid source and a Spout. Choose a supported filling recipe in JEI; an empty tank or placed pipe does not count.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Connect sources and destinations with pipes and power a Mechanical Pump. Transfer fluids through the connected endpoints; reversing rotation reverses pump direction.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Connect a powered pipe endpoint to compatible storage or an eligible world-fluid position. Fill/drain storage or interact with world fluid sources.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Supply a Spout with fluid and place a compatible input on a Depot or moving belt beneath it. Fill containers or perform supported filling recipes.
